Cost: 100eb (Premium) ♦ Required Slots: 1

Fits: All Ranged Weapons except Bows

Nobody likes being surprised by a stray round when they peak a corner.

Installs a mount that can accept any variety of Gun Shield. Gun Shields function as Bulletproof Shields (including for mods, tech upgrades, etc), but may only be utilized while the weapon is being wielded in two hands and while the user has yet to move further than 4m/yds on foot in a Round. The Gun Shield can be deployed or retracted as an Action, or as part of an Action to stow the weapon or deploy it on a Bipod. While deployed, the weapon is not Concealable. While installed, the weapon cannot be installed as a Popup Weapon.

When a Gun Shield is destroyed, it is destroyed beyond repair, and must be replaced with another Gun Shield and 1 minute of time. Only one Gun Shield Mount may be installed. Available Gun Shields include:

  • Light: 50eb (Costly) — 5 HP
  • Medium: 100eb (Premium) — 10 HP, Incompatible with Underbarrel Attachments except Angled Foregrip or Foregrip.
  • Heavy: 250eb (Expensive) — 15 HP, Incompatible with Underbarrel Attachments, cannot be equipped to Pistols or SMGs, counts as Thick Cover for the purposes of Tech Rebuilds.

Attachment slots: 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Attachment Catalog > Rails & Mounts).
